serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Do you need my help with something?
Lady Annalie: I-I don’t even know how to start… Everything is wrecked and my stuff is gone…
Lady Annalie: All these clothes…{{wi}} My head hurts just from thinking how much money I lost…
Lady Annalie: Business wasn’t going so well either way because of the online shopping and opening of a big shopping centre nearby, but this is pretty much a nail in the coffin…
You: …
Lady Annalie: I have been sitting here, crying… {{wi}}I don’t…{{wi}} Why did this happen?
You: Listen Annalie, if you want I can help you, just tell me what to do.
Lady Annalie: Right…{{wi}} There’s no point being a crybaby. I need to start trying to fix things here.
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Lady Annalie: Do you really want to help? It’s going to be a lot of work and I wouldn’t want to bother you.
You: It’s alright! I have the time to help.
You: You are a good girl, I’m sure you would help me too if I was in a situation like this.
#Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Lady Annalie: Thanks! 
You: What should we start with?
#Annalie.face.sad
Lady Annalie: Uh…{{wi}} No idea…
Lady Annalie: I think we should throw out all the broken stuff and clean this place up.
You: Good idea.
